entities.name: Library Management System
entities.description: Provides cataloging, circulation, and self-service portals while enforcing EU data residency, high-performance search, and role-based access control.

entities.name: Library Patrons
entities.description: Students and public users who access the self-service portals and search the catalog.

entities.name: Librarians
entities.description: Circulation staff who manage daily library operations and patron accounts.

entities.name: Library Administrators
entities.description: Administrators who oversee system configurations and manage diverse user personas.

entities.name: EU Identity Provider (IdP)
entities.description: Manages authentication and token exchange using OIDC.

entities.name: Payment Gateway
entities.description: Processes transactions via REST/JSON over HTTPS.

entities.name: Digital Content Providers
entities.description: Supplies external digital content and media via APIs over HTTPS.

interfaces.description: Performs administrative tasks and role-based access control
Authenticates users and handles token exchange
Processes payments for fines and services
Retrieves digital content and media resources

naming_conventions: External systems use descriptive titles followed by their protocol or context in parentheses if applicable.
User personas are named in plural form representing user groups (e.g., 'Library Patrons', 'Librarians').
